embeds.title: Previously reported products (still in the 90-day window)

fields.name: NVIDIA DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering (in NBA 2K27)
fields.value: NVIDIA — NVIDIA states "DLSS 5 is available now in the newly-released NBA 2K27" and that DLSS 5 introduces "3D-Guided Neural Rendering, infusing games with lifelike lighting and materials using advanced artist-guided AI models." It ships alongside Game Ready Driver 616.64.

fields.name: 007 First Light — Path Tracing & DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction Update
fields.value: NVIDIA — NVIDIA and IO Interactive shipped a free update adding path tracing and DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction to 007 First Light on PC (GeForce RTX), improving lighting, shadows, reflections and global illumination, alongside existing DLSS Super Resolution and Multi Frame Generation, with the game also playable via GeForce NOW.

fields.name: HappyOyster 1.0 "Adventure" mode via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Open API
fields.value: Alibaba — Alibaba's Bailian (Model Studio) "newly released models" catalog added happyoyster-1.0-adventure, exposing the Adventure/world-exploration mode of the HappyOyster real-time interactive world model as a standalone, priced Open API endpoint, distinct from the consumer happyoyster.cn site and from the happyoyster-1.0-directing/-acting endpoints. Alibaba Cloud documentation lists per-call/per-second pricing (~$0.007067 per World Creation call, ~$0.028267 per second of World Experience at 480p).

fields.name: Roblox Scene Generator (prompt-to-scene for Build & Studio)
fields.value: Roblox — Roblox announced Scene Generator, which will power prompt-to-scene functionality across both Build and Studio, letting creators turn a text prompt and reference image into a fully functional layout to refine in Studio.

fields.name: RDC 2026 roadmap items — NPC Dynamic Behavior, New Default Movement, Silhouette-preserving Layered Clothing
fields.value: Roblox — At RDC 2026, Roblox previewed NPC Dynamic Behavior ("populate games with dynamic NPCs through prompts in Studio," coming late 2026), New Default Movement (motion matching + root motion for avatars, coming early 2027), and Silhouette-preserving Layered Clothing (coming early 2027), per the official devforum recap.

fields.name: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction, 2nd-generation transformer model (early access)
fields.value: NVIDIA — NVIDIA states a "new 2nd generation transformer model" for DLSS Ray Reconstruction with "35% more compute capability" that "processes 20% more parameters, while maintaining similar performance to the previous model." It is available now as an early-access download.

fields.name: Markerless Motion Capture (EA Create Capture)
fields.value: Electronic Arts — EA's motion-capture group (EA Create Capture) has moved markerless mocap — tracking actor movement via cameras and AI/computer vision without marker suits or a dedicated volume — into production use for EA SPORTS FC (player movement/ball interactions) and EA SPORTS UFC (martial-arts technique captur

fields.name: Roblox Build — mobile AI creation tab (public alpha, New Zealand)
fields.value: Roblox — Roblox states a mobile-first creation tab inside the Roblox app that uses its AI tools, including Cube, which "turns a prompt into game-ready objects, from simple props to vehicles that drive and weapons that shoot," and already-launched Procedural Models.

fields.name: Autodesk 3ds Max 2027.2 — native 3D Gaussian Splat support
fields.value: Autodesk — Autodesk states "New 3D Gaussian Splat (3DGS) support in 3ds Max 2027.2 provides fast rendering, simple editing, and hyper-accurate output," with a new point object type and point-data modifiers to "edit 3DGS data or create point data from scratch." Arnold "now works with native 3ds Max 3DGS data."

fields.name: Adobe Substance 3D Painter 12.1, Designer 16 and Sampler update (OpenPBR)
fields.value: Adobe — Adobe states Painter 12.1 adds Skew Map Painting, Auto Rebake (rebakes only affected mesh portions), a Hard Surface Auto UV mode and OpenPBR support; Designer 16 adds a Shape Splatter v2 node, Signed Distance Field nodes, a 3D Viewer node and new displacement controls; Sampler adds Material Creation

fields.name: Fortnite / UEFN v41.20 — Control Rig for Sidekicks, in-world UMG widgets, LLM-powered NPCs
fields.value: Epic Games — Epic's release notes state Control Rig support for Sidekicks arrives with "three archetypes — Dog Large, Dog Small, and Cat Small" built on Epic's internal rig structures; creators can "drag your UMG User Widget from the content browser into the viewport to display your UI in the level"; and on July

fields.name: Upgraded PSSR in Doom: The Dark Ages on PS5 Pro (Free Update 4)
fields.value: Sony Interactive Entertainment — The PlayStation Blog states the upgraded PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) ML upscaler is applied to Doom: The Dark Ages on PS5 Pro from the July 7 update.

fields.name: 《逆水寒：新世界》(Justice Online: New World) character rendering upgrade
fields.value: NetEase — NetEase's official channel states the New World version brings "全新超精度面部模型" (a new ultra-high-precision facial model) with improved contours, texture and lighting, a lighting system where hair stays clear when backlit ("逆光也清晰、发丝会呼吸"), and a "立体进化" (3D evolution) of hair-strand and cloth dynamics.

fields.name: AMD FSR SDK 2.3 — FSR Upscaling 4.1.1 on RDNA 3
fields.value: AMD — SDK bundling FSR Upscaling 4.1.1, FSR Frame Generation 4.0.1 and FSR Ray Regeneration 1.2.0, extending the ML upscaler from RDNA 4 to RDNA 3 cards.
